draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 3 agosto 2026
draft.excerpt: Lipani a lezione da Aquilani al Sassuolo, Arena pronto per la Nations Championship, Baldanzi vuole ripagare De Rossi al Genoa: i giovani azzurri continuano a costruire il loro percorso verso il 2030.
draft.excerptEn: Lipani learning from Aquilani at Sassuolo, Arena ready for the Nations Championship, Baldanzi wants to repay De Rossi's faith at Genoa: young Italians continue building their path to 2030.
draft.bodyIt:
**Tommaso Baldanzi**
Il fantasista è tornato al Genoa e non vede l'ora di ripagare la fiducia di mister De Rossi con prestazioni solide. Un giovane talento che sa di avere una grande chance davanti. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQdDFtUERQVlM5dWpKRC1INEdWRHBzeTBSbU40Tk1VbGpaWmxuTUxVdVNid2lTSGczOVZTSW5uMEUwR25tSzVlSXpXbi1SWU1tYWMxcUM5X2lsaUdaVnJsVnFLRG9XdHg5MlFJNDFpMkxIN3pmZXhZdUNIMTJLMWN0NFBvS0NhdDY2YnBuOHZYaFBoTkQ2OS1RUTZyMHBmTzBYeFN1LV9oM09abnY4UE5pcXk0T1Q3Y00?oc=5)

**Antonio Arena**
L'esterno azzurro sarà in campo per la Nations Championship 2026 contro la Nuova Zelanda, trasmessa su Sky Sport Arena. Un'occasione importante per affermarsi sulla scena internazionale e accumulare minuti preziosi. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNVWhraVYyODg0Z1VaemJucUkyeVo3YUpkam00elV5Rk5pZk1FcF9SRFNLZm5iTHk2bElUYUNBdV9aR3ZvamxOR1BsbXJWWmpHUmNySVYxeTdwSF95QWdzbmNoVV9GWTVQN2J3MTlBZkRfMmw4eXVWc0lZS2VDN2hkY1VrUUFmbGx1ZVlWenozY3QwcXJpbjlXeGJYU2RiTmRsQ25ONW9CX0dXQmQ0SG9wS0VkQWM?oc=5)

**Luca Lipani**
Il giovane talento del Sassuolo ha scelto di imparare dai consigli di Aquilani, consapevole che solo il campo e le prestazioni porteranno chiamate della Nazionale. Un atteggiamento maturo che lo proietta verso il prossimo ciclo azzurro. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQMHVOaVIyZEtUc293b3YzTUVuU2F4c3ZNcEgxeWFNUVJIZHNNWHB2MXdqOTdMbWlnRUdva2R2R1VMVW1sYmlvbkcyV0JpdDRvM2hkZ2ZNYTZQR1Q4UGxyMzVVVzVPS0xQTGN5Z2pXSUNHcFYwajNfTHJCQXhBQS0zVmFMaG16aktBMmdINzMxcTdMRjM0MHVRTkx6ZVZ5ZExXZ05KRHJR?oc=5)

**Renato Marin**
Il calciomercato dell'Avellino segue con attenzione le prestazioni del giovane contro le squadre italiane, valutandone il potenziale per la categoria. Un'opportunità per crescere e farsi notare nel nostro calcio. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNcldsZHktamY1di1jVEJ6V3h6N0sxbHZYejg0YVVTc0VmVjY5U2JXTDJSVms0SzZIOFNvdFJMRXhJUkNXSXNGQ1lYQnVzNWo3TEVGbjV5dzg1UWJRcXB1bkE1cFpGOHhVS05EYVpaMVdWRHVWZVR1Q0lsOHI4TE9Tbk1aOHlNXzRFWXFTenp6c2dnWG13QVhyN0J2eGxldDRNSGlYNTFKcXV5Y3dnRzdYZHp4T25kZw?oc=5)

**Tommaso Baldanzi**
The playmaker has returned to Genoa and is eager to repay the faith of coach De Rossi with solid performances. A young talent who knows he has a great chance ahead. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQdDFtUERQVlM5dWpKRC1INEdWRHBzeTBSbU40Tk1VbGpaWmxuTUxVdVNid2lTSGczOVZTSW5uMEUwR25tSzVlSXpXbi1SWU1tYWMxcUM5X2lsaUdaVnJsVnFLRG9XdHg5MlFJNDFpMkxIN3pmZXhZdUNIMTJLMWN0NFBvS0NhdDY2YnBuOHZYaFBoTkQ2OS1RUTZyMHBmTzBYeFN1LV9oM09abnY4UE5pcXk0T1Q3Y00?oc=5)

**Antonio Arena**
The Italian winger will take the field for the 2026 Nations Championship against New Zealand, broadcast on Sky Sport Arena. An important opportunity to assert himself on the international stage and accumulate valuable minutes. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNVWhraVYyODg0Z1VaemJucUkyeVo3YUpkam00elV5Rk5pZk1FcF9SRFNLZm5iTHk2bElUYUNBdV9aR3ZvamxOR1BsbXJWWmpHUmNySVYxeTdwSF95QWdzbmNoVV9GWTVQN2J3MTlBZkRfMmw4eXVWc0lZS2VDN2hkY1VrUUFmbGx1ZVlWenozY3QwcXJpbjlXeGJYU2RiTmRsQ25ONW9CX0dXQmQ0SG9wS0VkQWM?oc=5)

**Luca Lipani**
The young Sassuolo talent has chosen to learn from Aquilani's advice, aware that only solid performances and results will bring national team calls. A mature attitude that points toward the next Italian cycle. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQMHVOaVIyZEtUc293b3YzTUVuU2F4c3ZNcEgxeWFNUVJIZHNNWHB2MXdqOTdMbWlnRUdva2R2R1VMVW1sYmlvbkcyV0JpdDRvM2hkZ2ZNYTZQR1Q4UGxyMzVVVzVPS0xQTGN5Z2pXSUNHcFYwajNfTHJCQXhBQS0zVmFMaG16aktBMmdINzMxcTdMRjM0MHVRTkx6ZVZ5ZExXZ05KRHJR?oc=5)

**Renato Marin**
Avellino's transfer market closely follows the young player's performances against Italian teams, assessing his potential in the category. An opportunity to grow and catch the eye in our football landscape. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNcldsZHktamY1di1jVEJ6V3h6N0sxbHZYejg0YVVTc0VmVjY5U2JXTDJSVms0SzZIOFNvdFJMRXhJUkNXSXNGQ1lYQnVzNWo3TEVGbjV5dzg1UWJRcXB1bkE1cFpGOHhVS05EYVpaMVdWRHVWZVR1Q0lsOHI4TE9Tbk1aOHlNXzRFWXFTenp6c2dnWG13QVhyN0J2eGxldDRNSGlYNTFKcXV5Y3dnRzdYZHp4T25kZw?oc=5)
